main.py.name: Flask application and root handler
main.py.description: Creates a Flask app, initializes Flask-Bootstrap, defines GET / returning fixed text about game progress, and starts the debug server when launched directly. Flask-Bootstrap is imported but missing from requirements.txt.

README.md.name: Owner usage guide
README.md.description: Describes the application and manual Python setup; it is not evidence of runtime success.

LICENSE.name: Original project license

GET /.name: Root response
GET /.description: Returns a fixed string about playing WoW and leveling. No game API, persisted state or automatic progress check is implemented.
